# Pixel Pomodoro Timer

A pixel-art themed Pomodoro timer built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No dependencies, no network requests, fully offline.

## Features

- 25-minute work mode and 5-minute break mode
- Start / Pause / Reset controls with large touch targets
- Big countdown display with MM:SS format
- Keyboard shortcuts: `Space` to start/pause, `R` to reset
- Accessible: labeled buttons, `aria-pressed` mode toggles, `aria-live` countdown
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Pixel aesthetic: blocky borders, stepped shadows, grid background

## Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step needed.

## Files

- `index.html` — semantic markup and controls
- `styles.css` — pixel-art theme, responsive layout, interaction states
- `app.js` — timer state machine with drift-free timestamp-based countdown
- `README.md` — this file

## Timer Logic

The countdown uses `Date.now()` timestamps rather than incrementing counters, preventing drift. A 250ms interval checks remaining time and re-renders only when the displayed second changes.

## Keyboard

- `Space` — start or pause
- `R` — reset current mode
- `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` — navigate controls
- `Enter` / `Space` on focused button — activate
